While Spider-man battles the dinosaurs (a Tyrannosaurus Rex, Brontosaurus, Triceratops, and Stegosaurus) in Manhattan during a snow storm, Curt Connors reverses the process reducing the dinosaurs to skeletons. Spider-Man rescues Billy Connors as Stegron flees. Stegron falls through the ice of a frozen river and disappears.
longest_story.notes:
Spider-man refers to the dinosaurs as the "Godzilla Gang" and "Gorgo and Company". Stegron would ride on the Tyrannosaurs' back as a mount.

Earlier in the story, Spider-Man had cured Curt Connors during a threeway battle between him, the Lizard, and Stegron, by web shooting the antidote to the Lizard affliction into his mouth.

longest_story.synopsis: Spider-Man has been zapped with a chemical depressant by Mysterio and lost his powers. Even worse, Aunt May has been murdered, leaving Peter alone in the world. As Spider-Man begins to piece things together, he comes to the realization that the killer he is hunting for is the same burglar who killed his Uncle Ben so many years ago. Powerless yet determined and learning that the burglar has merely captured rather than killed Aunt May, Spider-Man has a final confrontation with the man who changed his life forever.
longest_story.notes: Story in five chapters (plus epilogue): Chapter One: not numbered or separately titled. Chapter Two: Less Spider Than Man! Chapter Three: Let the Burglar Beware! Chapter Four: Murder Most Foul! Chapter Five: The Final Confrontation! Epilogue: Resolutions! The first page of this issue reveals that Stan Lee wrote one of the story pages and invites readers to guess which one it is, it was the last page "Epilogue" (this information taken from the letters page in Amazing Spider-Man #206).
